description: List YouTube videos whose transcripts were already delivered to this account, most recent first. Use it to find or reopen an earlier transcript. It fetches nothing and delivers no transcript. When more results exist, page with the returned cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Page size; defaults to the server default.

search.description: Optional video ID or title filter.

name: transcriptlab_list_transcripts
title: List transcript library
